articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed, avg 11 published/cycle (65 yesterday)

experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active, none is queued and there is no pause gate. Science is the only miss, at 3 against 5. Over the last nine days it averaged 5.6 a day (5, 6, 4, 4, 7, 8, 6, 7, then 3), so this is one low day and not a trend. The 2026-09-26 decision allows the science floor to go unmet.
weakestArea: Science is at 3 stories, against 5. All three came from Phys.org: the miniature Cas12m CRISPR proteins, the most distant quasar, and 5G interference with satellite weather forecasts. On a US holiday the volume was thinner (53 stories against 65), and politics and economy took the space. Quanta, Carbon Brief, SciDev.Net and Dialogue Earth each fed 3 items to the selector but led nothing. If science stays under 5 for three days, widen the science entries in CURATED_SOURCES in fetch-news-api.js. Do not raise the floor, and do not raise NewsAPI token use.
watching: Gulf war: an Iranian drone killed two Italian Rheinmetall staff in Kuwait, the Makkah pact meeting in Islamabad addressed the Saudi–Houthi war, and Kushner is running an Iran channel on Hormuz.
Monetary tightening: gold is at a 14-month low as a December Fed hike is priced in, OPEC+ rolled quotas into January, and Hernández de Cos leads the race to succeed Lagarde at the ECB.
Israel: Eisenkot's Democrats coalition deal puts the bloc at 48 seats ahead of the election.
Nigeria: gunmen fired on a Peter Obi rally in Benin City, and the Emefiele, Agunloye and Omokore corruption trials all moved.
Russia–Ukraine: Ukraine struck Savasleyka airbase, hitting five aircraft. The EU summit is weighing a €45 billion Ukraine loan against the budget.
Korea: Kim Jong Un ordered tactical nuclear weapons deployed.
Chip export controls: Nvidia halted AI chip shipments to Southeast Asia under the new licence rule.
coverageGaps: Oceania had no datelines today, after one yesterday.
Every science story came from Phys.org, while Quanta, Carbon Brief, SciDev.Net and New Scientist led none.
Climate and environment coverage was thin. The Ibiza diesel spill and California's king tides were the only entries, and the collapse of COP31 got no follow-up.
Latin America had 6% of datelines, mostly Brazil and Honduras. The Argentina recession story from yesterday got no follow-up.
context: This was Thanksgiving in the US, which explains the lighter volume and the low US dateline share (15%). Every cycle completed: the selector averaged 163s, the writer 130s and the editor 69s. Al Jazeera's share fell back to 17% from yesterday's 21%, so no source cap is needed.
